title: CommunicationPath
description: TOGAF-sourced interaction archetype — physical or logical communication channel between Nodes or Technology Components. The Effector→Receptor coupling through which infrastructure-level data flows. Extends Interaction with TOGAF Technology Architecture vocabulary. TOGAF mapping: Communication Path (Content Metamodel, Technology Architecture domain). Source framework: TOGAF (Technology Architecture, Content Framework).
